intended_object: A derivation showing that axiom 5 (◇φ → □◇φ) is provable in any modal proof system that contains axiom Tc (φ → □φ). It is used to build the `HasAxiomFive` instance. Inferred from the name and from the instance declared right after it.
explanation: This `def` defines no mathematical object. Its type `𝓢 ⊢ ◇φ ==> □◇φ` is a type of derivations: a proof that a formula can be derived in 𝓢. It is a `def` rather than a `theorem` only because derivations in this library live in `Type`. The body applies axiom Tc to the formula ◇φ, which is exactly the instance ◇φ → □◇φ. So it is really a lemma (axiom 5 is derivable in KTc), and its only role is to supply the `HasAxiomFive` instance. Mathlib has no counterpart.
